verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in evidence is Memory Export, which creates structured exports of many memories at once using Pydantic schemas. A single add call also extracts and stores multiple facts from one conversation, but that is ingestion, not a bulk operation over existing items. The CLI and MCP docs describe only per-memory add, search, list, update and delete, with no batch semantics. Missing for 10: documented batch update/delete endpoints, bulk operations via CLI or MCP, filter-based mass actions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
